mnemonic.meaning: 霜 has 雨 (rain) on top: frozen moisture.

examples.ja: 今朝は畑に霜が降りた。
examples.en: There was frost on the fields this morning.

items.note: 霜が降りる = frost forms. 霜焼け = chilblains.

mnemonic.meaning: 横 side + 断 cut: cutting across sideways.
mnemonic.reading: "OU, DAN!" (おうだん) Oh, Dan crosses. Note: 横 is おう here.

examples.ja: 横断歩道を渡ってください。
examples.en: Please use the pedestrian crossing.

items.note: 横断歩道 = crosswalk. Also crossing a continent: アメリカ横断.

mnemonic.meaning: 起 start + 源 source: where it started.
mnemonic.reading: "KEE, GEN!" (きげん) Same sound as 機嫌 (mood) and 期限 (deadline).

examples.ja: この祭りの起源は古い。
examples.en: This festival has old origins.

items.note: Formal. 始まり (Level 8) is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 公 fair + 正 just: fair and just.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, SAY!" (こうせい) Same sound as 構成 (composition) and 校正 (proofreading).

examples.ja: 公正な判断をお願いします。
examples.en: Please make a fair judgement.

items.note: Formal; justice and rules. 公平 (Level 17) is treating everyone equally.

mnemonic.meaning: 慣 has 忄 (heart): getting your heart used to something.
mnemonic.reading: "NARASU!" (ならす) Same sound as 鳴らす (Level 7).

examples.ja: 新しい靴を少しずつ足に慣らした。
examples.en: I gradually broke in my new shoes.

items.note: Transitive of 慣れる. 体を慣らす = to get your body used to something.

mnemonic.meaning: KAYUI: "Ka, you-ee!" A mosquito (蚊, か) made you itchy.

examples.ja: 蚊に刺されたところがかゆい。
examples.en: My mosquito bite is itchy.

items.note: Kanji: 痒い. かゆみ = itchiness.

mnemonic.meaning: 賞 prize + 品 article: a prize article.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOU, HIN!" (しょうひん) Same sound as 商品 (goods for sale).

examples.ja: 一位の賞品は自転車だった。
examples.en: The first prize was a bicycle.

items.note: An object given as a prize. 賞金 = prize money. 商品 = merchandise.

mnemonic.meaning: 穀 grain + 物 thing: grain things.
mnemonic.reading: "KOKU, MOTSU!" (こくもつ) Coke and grains.

examples.ja: 米や麦などの穀物を育てている。
examples.en: They grow grains like rice and wheat.

items.note: Formal. Rice, wheat, corn, beans.

mnemonic.meaning: 発 depart + 車 vehicle: the vehicle departs.
mnemonic.reading: "HASSHA!" (はっしゃ) Same sound as 発射 (launch, firing).

examples.ja: 電車はまもなく発車します。
examples.en: The train will depart shortly.

items.note: Vehicles leaving. 出発 is anyone departing. 発車時刻 = departure time.

mnemonic.meaning: 茹 has 艹 (plant): boiling vegetables.
mnemonic.reading: "YUDERU!" (ゆでる) You, dare to boil the eggs.

examples.ja: 卵を十分間茹でた。
examples.en: I boiled the eggs for ten minutes.

items.note: Usually in kana: ゆでる. ゆで卵 = boiled egg. 煮る (Level 20) is simmering with seasoning.

mnemonic.meaning: 湿 damp + 度 degree: degree of dampness.
mnemonic.reading: "SHITSU, DO!" (しつど) Shits do get damp.

examples.ja: 今日は湿度が八十パーセントだ。
examples.en: The humidity is eighty percent today.

items.note: A measured value. 湿気 (Level 23) is the moisture you feel.

mnemonic.meaning: 相 mutual + 続 continue: what continues from one to another.
mnemonic.reading: "SOU, ZOKU!" (そうぞく) So, the clan inherits.

examples.ja: 父の財産を相続した。
examples.en: I inherited my father's property.

items.note: Legal. 遺産相続 = inheriting an estate. 継ぐ (Level 10) = to take over.

mnemonic.meaning: 生 life + 理 logic: the logic of life.
mnemonic.reading: "SAY, REE!" (せいり) Same sound as 整理 (sorting).

examples.ja: 生理現象だから仕方がない。
examples.en: It's a bodily function, so it can't be helped.

items.note: Commonly means menstruation: 生理痛 (period pain). 生理学 = physiology.

mnemonic.meaning: 卸 = to unload goods for sale.
mnemonic.reading: "OROSU!" (おろす) Same sound as 下ろす (Level 15).

examples.ja: この会社は野菜を店に卸している。
examples.en: This company sells vegetables wholesale to shops.

items.note: 卸売り = wholesale. Also grating: 大根をおろす (often 下ろす / おろす).

mnemonic.meaning: 老 old: being old.
mnemonic.reading: "OI!" (おい) Oi! Old age catches up.

examples.ja: 最近、老いを感じる。
examples.en: I've been feeling my age lately.

items.note: Literary. 年をとる is everyday for aging. 老人 = elderly person.

mnemonic.meaning: 梅 plum + 雨 rain: rain when plums ripen.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUYU!" (つゆ) Special reading. Same sound as 露 (dew, Level 21). Also ばいう.

examples.ja: 梅雨が明けると、夏が来る。
examples.en: When the rainy season ends, summer comes.

items.note: June–July in most of Japan. 梅雨明け = end of the rainy season.

mnemonic.meaning: 蕎 buckwheat + 麦 wheat: buckwheat grain.

examples.ja: 昼ご飯に蕎麦を食べた。
examples.en: I had soba for lunch.

items.note: Usually そば. 年越しそば is eaten on New Year's Eve.

mnemonic.meaning: 煮 has 灬 (fire): cooked over fire.

examples.ja: 野菜がよく煮えた。
examples.en: The vegetables are cooked through.

items.note: Intransitive partner of 煮る (Level 20). 煮え切らない = indecisive.

mnemonic.meaning: 便 = convenient delivery: news that comes to you.
mnemonic.reading: "TAYORI!" (たより) Same sound as 頼り (reliance).

examples.ja: 故郷の母から便りが届いた。
examples.en: A letter came from my mother back home.

items.note: Literary. 便りがないのは良い便り = no news is good news.

mnemonic.meaning: 洗 wash + 剤 agent: a washing agent.
mnemonic.reading: "SEN, ZAI!" (せんざい) Same sound as 潜在 (latent).

examples.ja: 食器用の洗剤がなくなった。
examples.en: We're out of dish soap.

items.note: 洗濯用洗剤 = laundry detergent.
